title: Absurdity
summary: ABSURD'ITY, noun 1. The quality of being inconsistent with obvious truth, reason, or sound judgment. Want of judgment, applied to men; want of propriety, applied to things. 2. That which is absurd; in

inlines.v: ABSURD'ITY, noun 1. The quality of being inconsistent with obvious truth, reason, or sound judgment. Want of judgment, applied to men; want of propriety, applied to things. 2. That which is absurd; in this sense it has a plural; the absurdities of men.
